theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have h₁ : relation d e := h.1
  have h₂ : relation e f := h.2
  have h₃ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) := (hrelation d e).mp h₁ |>.2
  have h₄ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) := (hrelation e f).mp h₂ |>.2
  
  have h₅ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := by
    intro i
    have : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      rw [hdigits_to_num]
      calc
        (∑ j, (if j = i then e j else d j) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ))
          = ∑ j, (d j + if j = i then e j - d j else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h] <;> ring
        _ = ∑ j, d j * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) + ∑ j, (if j = i then e j - d j else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
          simp [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    rw [this]
    exact h₃ i

  have h₆ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := by
    intro i
    have : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      rw [hdigits_to_num]
      calc
        (∑ j, (if j = i then f j else e j) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ))
          = ∑ j, (e j + if j = i then f j - e j else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h] <;> ring
        _ = ∑ j, e j * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) + ∑ j, (if j = i then f j - e j else 0) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
          simp [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    rw [this]
    exact h₄ i

  have h₇ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d + ∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      rw [hdigits_to_num]
      calc
        (∑ i, e i * 10 ^ (i : ℕ))
          = ∑ i, (d i + (e i - d i)) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            ring
        _ = ∑ i, d i * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + ∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num d + ∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
          simp [hdigits_to_num]
    have : 7 ∣ ∑ i, ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) := by
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro i _
      exact h₅ i
    have : ∑ i, ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) = ∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      <;> simp
    have : 7 ∣ ∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [← this]
      exact this
    have : digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d = 2 * digits_to_num d + ∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      rw [this]
      <;> ring
    have : 7 ∣ (∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ)) + 2 * digits_to_num d := by
      have : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := by use digits_to_num d
      have : (∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ)) + 2 * digits_to_num d = ((∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ)) + 9 * digits_to_num d) - 7 * digits_to_num d := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact dvd_sub this this
    rw [← this]
    exact this

  have h₈ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro i
    have : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d := by
      have : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := h₆ i
      have : 7 ∣ ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e) - (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) := by
        exact dvd_sub this h₇
      have : ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e) - (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) = (f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact this
    have : 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := h₅ i
    have : 7 ∣ ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d) + ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) := by
      exact dvd_add this this
    have : ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) - digits_to_num d) + ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) = (f i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact this

  have h₉ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i := by
    intro i
    have : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := h₈ i
    have : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) := by
      have : (7 : ℕ).Prime := by decide
      have : ¬(7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
        intro h
        have : (7 : ℕ) ∣ (10 : ℕ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by norm_cast at h ⊢
        have : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := by exact Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow this this
        norm_num at this
      have : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (f i - d i) ∨ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
        apply (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)).dvd_mul.mp
        exact this
      cases this with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h => exfalso; exact this h
    have : 7 ∣ -(f i - d i) := by exact dvd_neg.mpr this
    have : -(f i - d i) = d i - f i := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact this

  intro i
  exact h₉ i
